name: Fire Dungeon
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW Fire Dungeon mobile battle-page background in this exact game's illustrated style. Input 1 is the approved cave background: match its quiet composition, large simple forms, soft contrast and outline treatment. Input 2 is a style reference for the game's chunky clean silhouettes; do not copy its gate. STYLE: Match the supplied game art: clean chunky cartoon illustration, simple broad 2-3 tone cel-shaded shapes, confident muted dark-plum contours on edge objects, no photorealism, fine texture, tiny cracks, grain, 3D rendering, excessive gradients or intricate details. Theme palette: muted terracotta, smoky mauve, charcoal and restrained amber.
SCENE: A warm ember dungeon: broad terracotta cavern walls with a few simple carved stone recesses and a dim amber ember glow tucked into the extreme side edges. Dry smoky stone floor, quiet hazy central wall. Emphasize a sheltered underground ember chamber rather than an outdoor volcano; no flowing lava across the floor.
COMPOSITION: 9:20 portrait, 1440 x 3200. The board and UI cover most of the central upper area. Keep the central 76% of the width quiet and mostly featureless; put the theme's bold recognizable details at asymmetric extreme sides and corners, with varied shape, height and spacing. Avoid matching rows or repetitive paired clusters. Keep a broad low-contrast floor in the lower half, which matches this board material: pale muted terracotta and warm ash stone, faint broad dusty rose and clay mottling, only tiny flat ash flecks; no fire, embers, glowing cracks or lava on the board. Board and panels must read clearly. No high-contrast rocks, liquid, branches or objects crossing the central clearing. Keep details visible close enough to the sides for a narrow phone composition, but modest in size. Restrained gentle dark-plum outline weights like input 1; clean bold outer contours on side objects. No board, grid lines, purple divider, baked frame, rounded-corner mask, icons, characters, text or labels. Full bleed opaque image. Output only ONE finished background, no collage or comparison.
